base_prompt: Use case: compositing. Redesign this single 16:9 YouTube art-history slide for outstanding TV/mobile readability. Image 1 is original slide/content reference; image 2 is REQUIRED full background, preserve its golden clouds and architectural dark edges. Further images are actual artwork inserts, reproduce faithfully, never redraw or invent artwork details. Sophisticated museum editorial design, charcoal large Traditional Chinese typography over ivory panels, warm gold accents, lively clear visual hierarchy, spacious margins. Remove clutter and oversized section numbers. Headings roughly 60-72px and body 34-42px minimum at 1280x720 equivalent. Use short natural lines, never overlap images and text, all lettering crisp. No watermark. Output one finished slide only.
